activeSession.task: Redesigned the Courriers module end-to-end, mirroring the Missions redesign process exactly (Phase 1 audit → Phase 2 plan → registry → guided creation → detail workspace → live validation). Deleted the old split-pane list + flat single-step form. New GET /api/courriers/aggregates + a real Période (date-range) filter + an enDepassement filter sharing threshold logic with the aggregates endpoint. Then two feedback-driven follow-ups: (1) implemented all three 'future recommendation' items from the redesign report — real schema work for contact-level sender/recipient (courriers.expediteurContactId/destinataireContactId, nullable FK → contacts, a refinement of the org link not a replacement) and multi-document attachment (new courrier_documents join table, migration 0013 backfills existing single-document links, dedicated add/remove endpoints), plus standardized MISSION_PAGE_SIZE/COURRIER_PAGE_SIZE to 8 matching Accords/Partenaires; (2) added quick-create organisation/contact dialogs (reusing Partenaires' FormulaireOrganisation/FormulaireContact, same pattern as Missions' quick-create) and unlocked the edit form's expéditeur/destinataire/date/réponse-requise fields (previously silently immutable server-side) — with a server-side safety check that rejects an organisation change unless the contact is also explicitly updated or cleared, verified live against real data (correctly threw CONTACT_EXPEDITEUR_INVALIDE, then succeeded once the contact was cleared).
